description: This file defines APIs for managing Ethernet Interface objects in a data model library, including functions for retrieving, setting, validating, and committing interface parameters, as well as accessing Ethernet interface statistics.
external_methods: cosa_apis.h (implied, as it provides foundational API definitions)

methods.name: Interface_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of Ethernet interface entries.

methods.name: Interface_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Ethernet interface entry by index.

methods.name: Interface_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets a boolean parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Gets an integer parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets an unsigned long parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_Validate
methods.description: Validates the parameters for an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: Interface_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back changes to an Ethernet interface.

methods.name: AssociatedDevice1_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of associated devices.

methods.name: AssociatedDevice1_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific associated device entry by index.

methods.name: AssociatedDevice1_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string parameter value for an associated device.

methods.name: AssociatedDevice1_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the associated device data has been updated.

methods.name: AssociatedDevice1_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the associated device data.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves boolean statistic parameter.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves integer statistic parameter.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves unsigned long statistic parameter.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string statistic parameter.

methods.name: _getMac
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address for a given interface name.
